_comment: Prompt rules shared by every look. Each rule is here because the model got it wrong without it; the reason is in 'why'.

why.only_her: without it the model draws its own desk and chair under her
why.keep_eyes: without it the eyes come out rounder and larger and she stops looking like herself
why.mouth: a flat-colour mouth looks pasted on; realistic teeth do not match the line art; both were tried
why.yawn: a yawn with teeth showed a row of small squares
why.sleeve: the picture is cut off at the bottom, which left a straight edge and a right-angle corner; asking for a bigger redraw made the sleeve puffy

frame: Keep the same camera framing, scale and position in the frame, and cut her off along the same flat horizontal line at the bottom as in the attached image.
transparent: Fully transparent background (real alpha channel, no matte, no fringe, every hair strand with natural soft alpha).
only_her: Draw ONLY her. No desk, no table, no chair, no tabletop, no furniture, no props, no shadows on any surface.
same: Keep the woman, hair, outfit, pose, position, scale and lighting exactly identical, pixel-level consistent.
keep_eyes: Keep her eye shape and eye size exactly as they are (not rounder, not larger).
mouth: The open mouth is a moderate, natural size (not wide, not stretched). Render it with exactly the same line art and soft cel shading as her eyes and lips: a thin dark-brown outline around the mouth with the same line weight as the lip line, an interior shaded from a deeper rosy pink at the back to a lighter tone near the tongue with soft gradients, a small tongue with a faint curved line, and the upper teeth as one narrow light-cream strip with soft shading and a thin outline, with no individual teeth. No flat uniform colour fills, no realistic photographic teeth.
yawn_mouth: A small rounded open mouth. NO TEETH are visible at all: the open mouth shows only the soft pink interior and a little tongue, drawn with a thin outline and soft shading in the same style as her lips, with no white anywhere inside the mouth.

faces.happy: a bright smile with both eyes closed in happy curves. {mouth}
faces.shy: a bashful, modest look: a light blush on the cheeks, her eyes glancing aside, a small gentle smile.
faces.sleepy: half-closed sleepy eyes and a small yawn. {yawn_mouth}
faces.think: a thinking look, eyes glancing up and to the side, lips slightly pursed.
faces.cheer: an excited open-mouth smile with sparkling eyes. {mouth}
faces.blink: both eyes gently closed as in a natural blink, still smiling softly.

eyes.prompt: You are given two images of the same woman. Image 1 is the picture to keep: outfit, hairstyle, pose, framing. Image 2 is her original face: the reference for her EYES and face identity. Redraw image 1 exactly (same outfit, hairstyle, pose, position, scale, lighting). {transparent} {only_her} Give her the exact eye shape, eye size, eyelid line, iris size and gentle almond proportions of image 2: NOT larger, NOT rounder, NOT wider. Her gaze is calm, soft and attentive, looking at the viewer, with a gentle natural smile, eyelids relaxed at the height of image 2 (not half-closed, not dreamy, not wide open).

sleeve.prompt: Keep EVERYTHING exactly identical: the woman, her face, eyes, hair, clothes, the exact sleeve shape, the slim fitted volume of the sleeves and forearms, her hands, pose, position, scale, lighting, and the transparent background. {only_her} Change ONLY the bottom edge of the figure: the sleeves and forearms are cut off by a straight horizontal line with a sharp right-angle corner at the right end. Redraw only that lower contour so the sleeve ends in a natural, soft, gently curved shape with a rounded corner, like a sleeve resting on a table, with no straight horizontal cut longer than a few pixels and no right angles. Do NOT add volume, puffiness, extra folds or extra fabric; the sleeve keeps the same thickness and silhouette everywhere else.
